title: My ex kept my Netflix for two years, so I renamed his profile every week
hook: My ex kept using my Netflix for two years, so I renamed his profile every week.
narration: My ex kept using my Netflix for two years, so I renamed his profile every week. Week one, it said Ghost. Week twelve, Rent Free. I never blocked him. I never messaged him. I just changed the name every Sunday and watched his continue-watching list grow. Week ninety-one, someone new logged in from his TV. Profile name that week: Still Paying Nothing. She screenshotted it and messaged me on Instagram. Not angry. Curious. We talked for three hours. She'd been paying for the account she thought was his. Turns out he'd told her he covered all the bills. He now pays for his own Netflix, and for her subscription too, as an apology. She still texts me. He doesn't know we're friends. So. Too petty, or perfectly petty?
verdict: Ninety-one weeks of restraint is not petty. It's patient.
